USB/field priority mux. Field (IN1) wins whenever valid; USB (IN2) otherwise. Fast 5us switchover in XCOMP mode. Reverse-current blocking keeps field power off the USB host. OV1/OV2 unused (GND); BQ24074 retains its own input OVP.
PR1 divider top: PR1 = 0.301 x 5V_FIELD (1.51 V at 5.0 V).
PR1 divider bottom. Field keeps priority while PR1 > CP2: down to 4.14 V field at 5.00 V USB, 4.35 V at 5.25 V USB.
CP2 divider top: CP2 = 0.249 x VBUS. CP2 >= VREF (fast-switchover XCOMP mode) for VBUS >= 4.41 V.
CP2 divider bottom.

ST pull-up (datasheet 6-20k). High = field/IN1 or no output, low = USB/IN2.
Open by default (field priority). Bridge for bench work to make USB win whenever valid; with USB absent the field input still powers the board.

AND-OR: SOURCE_QUALIFIED = (FIELD_PG AND PWR_SRC) OR USB_HIGH_CURRENT. Field qualifies only while U10 actually selects IN1 (ST high), so JP2/USB-priority on a weak USB port can no longer select BQ ILIM. TI SCES606: Y=(A.B)+C, inputs 5.5 V tolerant, Ioff.
U11 local decoupling.
FIELD_PG pulldown. Pull-up lives on the interface board from 5V_FIELD, so an absent/unpowered field converter can never qualify a weak USB port.

Mates with Samtec CLP-105-02 family; stack height set by case. Land is the KiCad generic 1.27 mm THT header - verify against Samtec drawing.

LCSC C556936. Keliking 4x4x2 mm magnetic transducer, 12 ohm, rated 3 Vo-p, 73 dBA min at 10 cm / 4 kHz, 100 mA max mean. Alternate FUET-4020 (C391027), same land pattern, quieter. Needs a sound port in the front cover.

LCSC C15127. High-side P-FET. v0.5.2: gate is AC-coupled from GPIO8 (C45) with R45 to the source and clamp D7, so only PWM edges turn it on; any static GPIO8 level leaves it off within about 32 ms worst case (simulated).
Flyback across the buzzer coil.

Buzzer supply isolation with C44 (~50 us). 4.7R keeps the coil near its 3 V rating. v0.5.2: a stuck-low GPIO8 no longer holds DC in the coil (AC-coupled gate), so the 0.19 W fault case is gone. Any 0805 >= 0.25 W 4.7R is acceptable.
LCSC C59461. Buzzer reservoir: supplies the 4 kHz coil pulses locally (about 10 uF effective at 3 V). v0.5.2: moved >= 1.5 mm from the board edge.
LCSC C1525. Buzzer gate coupling capacitor. With R45: tau 6.8 ms.
LCSC C36871. Gate return to the Q4 source: Q4 is off 14 ms typ / 32 ms worst simulated corner after GPIO8 stops toggling.

LCSC C8522 (JSCJ). Gate clamp / DC restore: anode gate, cathode Q4 source. Low-Vf Schottky is required: a 1N4148 clamp leaves Q4 with only -2.39 V of gate drive at 2 kHz / 90 % (below the 2.5 V Rds(on) spec point).
LCSC C132016. 3V3 supervisor, 2.93 V threshold, open drain, 200 ms typ delay. Pulls the reset RC node low (through R46), never ESP_EN: U8 drives ESP_EN push-pull.
LCSC C11702. Limits the C9 discharge current into the U12 open-drain output to 3.3 mA; low level 69 mV, discharge tau 1 ms.
LCSC C1525. U12 supply bypass.

nfc_profile.future_battery_profile: Voltage-aware TXLDO setting required before future battery qualification.

usb_boot_gate_profile.truth: CHIP_EN = ESP_RESET_RC AND POWER_PERMIT with In1=GND
usb_boot_gate_profile.normal_selector: JP1 copper bridge1-2; USB_HIGH_CURRENT drives POWER_PERMIT
usb_boot_gate_profile.service_selector: Cut1-2 completely before solder bridge2-3; never bridgeboth
usb_boot_gate_profile.future_battery: Normal selector requires USB. Explicit service setting permits experimental battery boot but does not qualify battery charging, NFC TXLDO voltage profile, transient power, or protection.
usb_boot_gate_profile.cold_delay_scope: Empty C9 and valid3V logic step only; retained C9 charge after brief detach may allow immediate release once permission returns.
usb_boot_gate_profile.BQ_mode_settling: No guaranteed BQ EN2 transition bound established; full startup transient model has not completed.

field_power_profile.mux: U10 TPS2121 IN1=5V_FIELD priority, IN2=USB VBUS, XCOMP fast switchover; JP2 bridge = USB priority
field_power_profile.permission: SOURCE_QUALIFIED = (FIELD_PG AND PWR_SRC) OR USB_HIGH_CURRENT (U11 SN74LVC1G0832) -> BQ EN2 and JP1.1
field_power_profile.outline: Grown 6.5 mm on the right edge (x 65.5 -> 72.0) for y 0..37; stops above the Wi-Fi antenna keepout (y >= 38.7). J2 battery connector loses edge access (battery unsupported in v0.5).
field_power_profile.field_pg_qualification: Pull-up from 5V_FIELD on interface board; R37 100k pulldown on main board
field_power_profile.io0: IO_INT shared open-drain interrupt; R10/R11/C8 DNP
field_power_profile.startup_reanalysis_required: C9/R12 reset delay with U11 propagation and TPS2121 tSET/soft start

v051_profile.buzzer: BZ1 KLJ-4020 on 3V3 via R44/C44, Q4 AO3401A high side. v0.5.2: gate AC-coupled from GPIO8 (C45 100nF, R45 68k to source, D7 clamp). Firmware: LEDC on GPIO8, 2-5 kHz, timed beeps; idle level does not matter.
v051_profile.rgb: D5 XL-1615RGBC-RF common anode on VSYS; Q1/Q2/Q3 AO3400A low side on IO1 (G), IO3 (B), IO10 (R) via R16/R17/R18; 100k gate pulldowns.

v052_profile.buzzer_gate: C45 100nF series, R45 68k gate-source, D7 RB520S-30 clamp. Stuck-low GPIO8: Q4 off in 14 ms typ, 32 ms worst simulated corner (sim/results.json).
v052_profile.supervisor: U12 TLV803S 2.93 V open drain on 3V3 -> R46 1k -> ESP_RESET_RC (C9/R12/U8 In0). Release = 200 ms typ after 3V3 valid, then R12 x C9.
v052_profile.nfc_keepout: NFC rule areas extended from x 1.5 to the left board edge; the grounded edge strip is gone on all four layers.
v052_profile.stackup: 4 layers, 1.6 mm FR-4, 1 oz outer, 0.5 oz inner (see README for the 5V_FIELD inner-layer current note).
